sections.content: Live Intrusion Prevention System dashboard. Source: dbdome. Generated automatically by DBDOME.

sections.query: SELECT risk_level AS Severity, count(*) AS Count FROM alerts.alert_log  GROUP BY risk_level ORDER BY CASE risk_level WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT risk_level AS Severity, count(*) *100 / (select count(*) from alerts.alert_log) pct_of_total FROM alerts.alert_log  GROUP BY risk_level ORDER BY CASE risk_level WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT date_trunc('hour', entry_date)::timestamp AS time ,risk_level AS severity ,COUNT(*) AS count FROM alerts.alert_log where entry_date > current_date - interval '7 days' GROUP BY  risk_level, date_trunc('hour', entry_date)  ORDER BY     time;

select RC.issue_name as Type  , count(*)  AS Count from alerts.alert_log al join rootcause.v_rootcauses rc on rc.root_cause_id = al.root_cause_id where entry_date >  current_date - interval '7 days'  group by al.root_cause_id , issue_name limit 10

select RC.issue_name as Type  , count(*)  AS Count from alerts.alert_log al join rootcause.v_rootcauses rc on rc.root_cause_id = al.root_cause_id where entry_date >  current_date - interval '7 days'  group by al.root_cause_id , issue_name limit 10

SELECT root_cause_name AS Attack, issue_name AS Type, risk_level AS Severity, count(*) AS Count FROM alerts.mail_alert_log ma join rootcause.v_rootcauses rc on rc.root_cause_id  = ma.metric_name where entry_date > current_date - interval '7 days'  group by root_cause_name , issue_name ,risk_level ORDER BY CASE risk_level WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT root_cause_name AS Attack, issue_name AS Type, risk_level AS Severity, count(*) AS Count FROM alerts.mail_alert_log ma join rootcause.v_rootcauses rc on rc.root_cause_id  = ma.metric_name where entry_date > current_date - interval '7 days'  group by root_cause_name , issue_name ,risk_level ORDER BY CASE risk_level WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT root_cause_name AS Attack, issue_name AS Type, al.risk_level AS Severity, count(*) AS Count FROM alerts.alert_log al join rootcause.v_rootcauses rc on rc.root_cause_id  = al.root_cause_id where entry_date > current_date - interval '7 days' and al.risk_level = 'medium' group by root_cause_name , issue_name ,al.risk_level   LIMIT 20

SELECT count(*)*100 /(select count(*) from alerts.alert_log al1 where al1.entry_date > current_date - interval '7 days' ) pct_of_total , risk_level FROM alerts.alert_log al where al.entry_date > current_date - interval '7 days' and exists (select 1 from monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gmmr where gmmr.server = al.server and gmmr.metric_name = al.root_cause_id and gmmr.entry_date between al.entry_date - interval '1 second' and al.entry_date + interval '1 second') group by risk_level order by pct_of_total desc

SELECT count(*) *100 / (select count(*) from alerts.alert_log al1 where al1.entry_date > current_date - interval '7 days' ) pct_of_total ,risk_level, g.metric_metadata FROM alerts.alert_log al cross join lateral (select metric_metadata from monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gmmr where gmmr.server = al.server and gmmr.metric_name = al.root_cause_id and gmmr.entry_date between al.entry_date - interval '1 second' and al.entry_date + interval '1 second' limit 1) g where al.entry_date > current_date - interval '7 days' group by risk_level , g.metric_metadata order by pct_of_total desc limit 15

SELECT root_cause_name AS Attack, issue_name AS Type, risk_level AS Severity, count(*) AS Count FROM alerts.mail_alert_log ma join rootcause.v_rootcauses rc on rc.root_cause_id  = ma.metric_name where entry_date > current_date - interval '7 days'  group by root_cause_name , issue_name ,risk_level ORDER BY CASE risk_level WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT root_cause_name AS Attack, issue_name AS Type,al.risk_level severity   , count(*) AS Count FROM alerts.alert_log  al join rootcause.v_rootcauses rc on rc.root_cause_id  = al.root_cause_id  where entry_date > current_date - interval '7 days'  group by root_cause_name , issue_name ,al.risk_level LIMIT 20
